p = pd.read_csv(base+'payments.csv')
# March 2023 (non-leap year): day_of_year 60..90
t = p[(p.merchant=='Belles_cookbook_store')&(p.year==2023)&(p.day_of_year>=60)&(p.day_of_year<=90)]
vol = t.eur_amount.sum(); fraud = t[t.has_fraudulent_dispute].eur_amount.sum()/vol*100
print(len(t), vol, fraud)

def isnull(x):
    return x is None or (isinstance(x,float) and pd.isna(x))

def in_range(val, spec):
    if isnull(spec): return True
    s = spec.replace('%','')
    def num(x):
        x=x.strip().lower(); mult=1
        if x.endswith('k'): mult=1e3; x=x[:-1]
        elif x.endswith('m'): mult=1e6; x=x[:-1]
        return float(x)*mult
    if s.startswith('>'): return val > num(s[1:])
    if s.startswith('<'): return val < num(s[1:])
    if '-' in s:
        a,b = s.split('-'); return num(a) <= val <= num(b)
    return val == num(s)

def cap_ok(spec, cd):
    if isnull(spec): return True
    if cd in ('immediate','manual'): return spec==cd
    if spec in ('immediate','manual'): return False
    return in_range(float(cd), spec)

combos = t[['card_scheme','is_credit','aci','issuing_country','acquirer_country']].drop_duplicates()
ids=set()
for _,tx in combos.iterrows():
    intra = tx.issuing_country==tx.acquirer_country
    for _,f in df.iterrows():
        if f.card_scheme!=tx.card_scheme: continue
        if len(f.account_type) and m['account_type'] not in f.account_type: continue
        if len(f.merchant_category_code) and m['merchant_category_code'] not in f.merchant_category_code: continue
        if not isnull(f.is_credit) and bool(f.is_credit)!=bool(tx.is_credit): continue
        if f.aci is not None and len(f.aci) and tx.aci not in f.aci: continue
        if not isnull(f.intracountry) and bool(f.intracountry)!=intra: continue
        if not cap_ok(f.capture_delay, m['capture_delay']): continue
        if not in_range(vol, f.monthly_volume): continue
        if not in_range(fraud, f.monthly_fraud_level): continue
        ids.add(int(f.ID))
print(len(ids), ', '.join(map(str,sorted(ids))))"}
